bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-4c0b)" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0;")" = 7 || exit 63
result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --dry-run)" || exit 64
printf '%s\n' "$result"
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"mode":"--dry-run"' || exit 65
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"applied":0' || exit 66
printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 67
echo STARTLESS_EXISTING_PUBLIC_POST_DRY_RUN=PASS
echo STARTLESS_DRY_RUN_POST_MUTATION=NONE
